paper.title_en: Nanohertz gravitational waves from domain walls nucleated during inflation
paper.abstract_en: We investigate scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) produced by domain walls (DWs) nucleated via quantum tunneling during inflation with an extended nucleation time. In contrast to the small-period nucleation framework, in which DWs form over a narrow interval and possess nearly identical radii, we show that an extended nucleation period leads to a distribution of DW radii characterized by $γ\equiv\overline{R^4}/(\overline{R^2})^2>1$, which enhances the resulting curvature perturbations. We construct a two-field inflation model with an inflaton $φ$ and a spectator field $χ$ coupled through the potential $V(φ,χ)$, where the DW tension $σ(t)$ evolves smoothly as the inflaton rolls past a critical value. The characteristic width of this transition determines the cutoff scale $k_{\text{cut}}$ of the curvature power spectrum, enabling the SIGW peak to be placed in the nanohertz frequency band with detectable amplitude. For three representative parameter sets, we compute the SIGW spectra and find that the peak frequency ranges from $\sim10^{-8}$\,Hz to $\sim10^{-2}$\,Hz, with the nanohertz-peaked spectrum matching the NANOGrav and EPTA signals for suitable parameter choices. By selecting different parameters, our model can produce signals detectable by different gravitational-wave detectors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文通过扩展成核时间提出了一种新的畴壁产生机制，能够产生纳赫兹引力波信号，与NANOGrav和EPTA的观测相关，属于PTA主题，具有理论深度和一定的创新性。
decision.title_zh: 在暴胀期间成核的畴壁产生的纳赫兹引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在暴胀期间通过量子隧穿成核的畴壁（DWs）产生的标量诱导引力波（SIGWs），并考虑了扩展的成核时间。与成核时间短、DWs在狭窄区间内形成且半径几乎相同的框架相反，我们表明扩展的成核时期会导致DWs半径的分布具有γ≡R^4的平均值除以(R^2)^2的平均值>1的特征，这增强了由此产生的曲率扰动。我们构建了一个双场暴胀模型，其中包含暴胀子φ和通过势V(φ,χ)耦合的旁观场χ，当暴胀子滚过临界值时，DWs的张力σ(t)平滑演化。该转变的特征宽度决定了曲率功率谱的截止尺度k_cut，使得SIGW峰可以位于可探测振幅的纳赫兹频段。对于三组代表性参数，我们计算了SIGW谱，发现峰值频率范围从约10^-8 Hz到约10^-2 Hz，其中纳赫兹峰值谱与NANOGrav和EPTA信号匹配（在合适的参数选择下）。通过选择不同的参数，我们的模型可以产生能被不同引力波探测器探测到的信号。
